title: Canonical instance interfaces for the tensor of abelian sheaves
statement: Let $C$ be a category with a Grothendieck topology $J$, essentially small relative to the coefficient universe $\mathcal U$ [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;\mathrm{Ab}_{\mathcal U})$. Define its canonical tensor instance interfaces by specializing the sheafified tensor of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor] to abelian groups with tensor over $\mathbf Z$. The sheafification interface is left exact sheafification transported from a $\mathcal U$-small model of $C$. The monoidal and symmetric interfaces are precisely the corresponding fields of the specified sheaf tensor structure, with tensor $a(F\otimes_{\mathbf Z,p}G)$ and unit $a(\underline{\mathbf Z})$. The closed interface is a right-adjoint structure for this fixed tensor, obtained from its recorded closedness. The additive tensor interface and preservation of finite colimits by $F\otimes-$ are the specializations of the recorded tensor properties. These are interfaces to the specified tensor, not an arbitrary monoidal structure or additional hypotheses.
